title: Monthly Exec Roadmap Sync — Consolidated Deck & Action Tracker
creator: Evelyn Zhang
description: Prepare a single, consolidated monthly executive roadmap sync packet and a living action tracker that replaces ad-hoc slide decks. Goal: give execs and board stakeholders a concise view of progress vs. OKRs, major risks, data-backed performance signals (latency p50/p95, cost/token, Dedicated capacity utilization), and a clear set of owners for next steps.
acceptance_criteria: One consolidated slide deck (10 slides max) uploaded to Drive with approved narrative
Action tracker created in Confluence with assigned owners and due dates for all open items
Key metrics panel embedded from Console dashboards (latency p50/p95, cost/token, SLO breach count) and validated by Metrics owner
Two dry-run reviews completed: PM review and Exec sponsor review
Deck published to execs 48 hours before the monthly sync
updates: 2026-02-20: Ticket created. Initial outline drafted: 1) Highlights & asks, 2) OKR health, 3) Runtime metrics, 4) Major risks & mitigation, 5) Roadmap milestones, 6) Decision points, 7) Action tracker.
2026-02-25: Collected OKR status from product leads (embed table) — several components behind schedule due to kernel scheduling regressions (ENG-4821). Added as risk with mitigation timeline.
2026-03-01: Metrics owner (Priya Kumar) provided Console snapshots; p95 latency spike on 2026-02-28 traced to autoscaler misconfiguration. Added corrective action assigned to ENG-4987.

2026-03-04: Draft deck uploaded to Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBc-ROADMAP-DECK-2026-MAR — internal preview link. Feedback from CEO (Daniel Roberts): shorten technical appendix and call out customer-impacting regressions up front.
2026-03-07: Design review with UX (DES-330). Agreed on a compact slide template and a one-line 'ask' per slide. Designer uploaded hero visuals and timeline SVGs to Drive.

2026-03-09: Exec dry-run scheduled; created meeting notes template and pre-read checklist. Action tracker skeleton created in Confluence: https://confluence.redwood.com/display/ROADMAP/Exec-Action-Tracker-2026-03

2026-03-11: Dry-run with Exec sponsor (Marco Ruiz). Requested an explicit decision node on Dedicated vs. Hosted capacity for a large enterprise pilot; added as decision with owner Liam O'Connor and due_date 2026-03-25.

2026-03-12: Final edits: condensed technical appendix, added one slide with 'what success looks like' per OKR and linked to demo artifact in GitHub: https://github.com/redwood-inference/prod-readouts/pull/214

notes: Trade-offs considered: More raw telemetry (full dashboard) vs. concise executive narrative. Decided to include 2 key telemetry tiles and link to the full dashboard for self-service deep dives.
We intentionally moved A/B rollout details to appendix to keep primary deck <=10 slides. Appendix will live in Drive and be referenced in the action tracker.
This ticket is intended to replace previous ad-hoc QBR slide generation by standardizing the monthly template and keeping a living action tracker per month. Will evaluate adoption after three months.

Follow-up recommendation: schedule a 30-minute 'metrics alignment' session between PMs and Observability team to agree on canonical definitions (cost/token, tokenization counting) — suggested owner: Priya Kumar
